highlights.en:
A consensus extreme is not a trade by
itself; it is a warning that one side is finished.

When everyone is selling, it means buy. When everyone is buying, it
means sell.

By experiencing the constant conjunction of events behind mass
behavior, we can induce a logical response.

In a Nash equilibrium, rational players seek to maximize their
profit.
But the equilibrium price is not the best deal.

each swing
measures the pulling force that drives it to its maximum.

When there is no battery
left, the trend shuts down and the next phase is correction

By
watching shifting energy, we can see which side has more pulling power
from the impression force to reach its maximum.

the market is a salesman, and the mass shows its
passion for each item.

mindmap.en: How the three Volume papers fit
mindmap.note_en: Volume (2021), Qualifying Trades (2023) and Volume today (2025-2026) build on each other: from reading volume inside the matrix, to qualifying trades, to reading volume as sentiment.
mindmap.note_ar: ثلاث أوراق تبني بعضها على بعض: قراءة الـ volume داخل الـ matrix، ثم تأهيل الصفقات، ثم قراءة الـ volume بوصفه sentiment.

children.note_en: Volume accumulates along the move, is combined across feeds, and is read at its extreme, against the crowd.
children.note_ar: يتراكم الـ volume على امتداد الحركة ويُجمع من عدة مصادر ويُقرأ عند ذروته عكس الجمهور.

children.note_en: A consensus extreme is only a warning that one side is finished; the overlay, 3-C and setup are still needed. The question changed from 'is volume high?' to 'is everyone on the same side?'.
children.note_ar: ذروة الإجماع تحذير فقط؛ ونحتاج الـ overlay والـ 3-C والـ setup. السؤال صار: هل الجميع في الجانب نفسه؟

children.note_en: When everyone is selling, buy; when everyone is buying, sell. The crowd is wrong about the next move, not the one already made.
children.note_ar: حين يبيع الجميع اشترِ، وحين يشتري الجميع بِع. الجمهور يخطئ في الحركة التالية لا الماضية.

mindmap.note_en: A 2021 paper that seeks the most profitable type of 6&6 Setup using Game Theory and the Nash equilibrium.
mindmap.note_ar: ورقة من 2021 تبحث عن أكثر أنواع الـ 6&6 Setup ربحية باستخدام Game Theory والـ Nash equilibrium.

children.note_en: Study the cases where 6&6 succeeds or fails and find the cause of success, using Game Theory.
children.note_ar: ندرس حالات نجاح الـ 6&6 وفشله لنجد سبب النجاح باستخدام Game Theory.

children.note_en: 6&6 reflects mass behavior. Following Hume, we need not know the 'why'; we experience the constant conjunction of events and induce a logical response, framed as a Nash equilibrium.
children.note_ar: الـ 6&6 انعكاس لسلوك الجماهير. مع Hume لا نحتاج إلى «لماذا»، بل نعايش الاقتران الدائم ونستنتج استجابة منطقية تُصاغ كـ Nash equilibrium.

children.note_en: Reason is the slave of the passions; we only experience constant conjunction, never causation.
children.note_ar: العقل عبد للأهواء؛ ونعايش الاقتران الدائم لا السببية.

children.note_en: Rational players maximize profit; a professional trader looks for a great target. At the Intersection breakout, old losers take trades in the breakout direction and create more movement.
children.note_ar: اللاعبون العقلانيون يعظّمون الربح. عند كسر الـ Intersection يدخل الخاسرون القدامى في اتجاه الـ breakout فيولّدون حركة أكبر.

children.note_en: University teaches the equilibrium price as the best deal; the author argues the market is so competitive that it follows the Nash equilibrium instead.
children.note_ar: تُدرّس الجامعة أن السعر التوازني أفضل صفقة؛ والكاتب يرى أن السوق تنافسي فيتبع Nash.

mindmap.note_en: Trend, maximum profit and climax; the battery model; shifting energy and its effect on mass behavior.
mindmap.note_ar: الـ trend وأقصى ربح والـ climax؛ نموذج البطارية؛ والـ shifting energy وأثرها في سلوك الجماهير.

children.ar: الـ Trend وأقصى ربح والـ climax
children.note_en: Traders follow the trend only until they take maximum profit (Nash equilibrium). That is why markets seek oversold and overbought; each swing measures its pulling force, and at the maximum the energy is at climax, followed by correction.
children.note_ar: يتبع المتداولون الـ trend حتى يأخذوا أقصى ربح. لذلك يبحث السوق عن oversold وoverbought، وعند الأقصى تبلغ الطاقة الـ climax ثم يأتي التصحيح.

children.note_en: Oversold is the maximum point sellers can achieve; overbought the maximum point buyers can achieve.
children.note_ar: Oversold أقصى نقطة للبائعين، وoverbought أقصى نقطة للمشترين.

children.note_en: The market charges a battery that carries the trend until it runs out; then correction follows, like a phone going from 100% to 0%. Each swing has its own maximum and response (e.g. 100 pips at 0% versus 1,000 pips still at 50%).
children.note_ar: السوق يشحن بطارية تحمل الـ trend حتى تنفد ثم يأتي التصحيح. لكل swing أقصاه واستجابته (100 pips عند 0% مقابل 1,000 pips عند 50%).

children.note_en: Studying old swings shows which side, up or down, has greater pulling and impression forces, like testing two phones' batteries.
children.note_ar: دراسة الـ swings القديمة تُظهر أي جانب أقوى سحبًا وانطباعًا.

children.note_en: The battery is finished when the swing, compared with the old pulling force, shows a large difference. Watching shifting energy reveals which side has more pulling power.
children.note_ar: تنتهي البطارية حين يكون الفرق كبيرًا عن قوة السحب القديمة. مراقبة الـ shifting energy تكشف أي جانب أقوى سحبًا.

children.note_en: It changes mood and passion, shows the path of least resistance, appears in the response, and the response is everything (Jack's $100 example, constant conjunction).
children.note_ar: تغيّر المزاج والشغف، وتُظهر path of least resistance، وتظهر في الاستجابة، والاستجابة هي كل شيء (مثال Jack).

children.note_en: Jack cannot buy a $1,000 laptop, so he surely cannot buy a $200,000 house: the response tells us what to expect.
children.note_ar: من لا يستطيع شراء لابتوب بألف دولار لن يشتري بيتًا؛ الاستجابة تخبرنا بما نتوقع.

children.en: Lesson: trade with the mass passion
children.note_en: The market is a salesman and the mass shows passion for each item; professionals study that response and trade with it, up for positive mood, down for negative.
children.note_ar: السوق بائع والجماهير تُظهر شغفها؛ المحترف يتداول مع الاستجابة صعودًا أو هبوطًا.
